name: vadimgaidai
description: Spec-driven development for React: turn requirements into specifications, architecture plans, implementation, verification, and code review — guided by explicit architectural rules and consistent React conventions

plugins.name: react-feature-workflow
plugins.description: Build React features from a spec, not one long chat: spec, plan, implement, verify and review are each a command that reads the file the stage before wrote, and /review checks any branch against the convention skills with no spec. Ships React 19, TanStack Query and shadcn/ui skills plus Figma agents.

plugins.name: feature-sliced-design
plugins.description: Feature-Sliced Design guardrails: a skill that answers layer and import questions, a module scaffolder, and hooks that reject a misplaced file, a wrong filename, an upward/sideways import, or model content in the wrong place before it is written — not in review after.

plugins.name: feature-folders
plugins.description: Architecture-agnostic structure guardrails: global buckets (components, hooks, providers, lib, config, api) plus feature/page/layout modules, a scaffolder, and hooks that reject a new file outside them, a wrong filename, or model content (a type, a constant, a schema, a hook, an HTTP call) in the wrong place — placement and naming only ever block a new file, so a legacy project stays untouched.
